svg.data-weight-note: Table 88 (physical specifications) gives 65.5 lb (29.7 kg) for the chassis with midplane, fan tray, air filter and cable management brackets, and 221.03 lb (100.26 kg) for the maximum configuration. The guide's own prose disagrees with the table and is not carried - the rack-requirements and lift text give "up to 163.5 lb (74.2 kg) depending on the configuration" (the source of the 163.5 this file used to carry, where it was misread as kilograms), and the mounting-shelf note gives 128 lb (58.1 kg), which is the MX240's Table 88 maximum.
svg.data-power-typical-scope: AC typical power draw from the MX Series family datasheet, which names no configuration, ambient or side; DC 3150 W
svg.data-cooling-system-w: 160 W high-capacity (110 W normal); dedicated PSU tap
svg.data-max-thermal-output: AC 11,322 BTU/h (3318 W); DC 9,632 BTU/h (2823 W) (Table 89, which calls them estimates; provisioning ceiling)
